_note: The Codex builder (cockpit ruling E7): workspace-write, no network; writable are the item's working copy, JOB_SCRATCH and TMPDIR — /tmp is excluded and no git directory is writable (the working copy is a linked worktree: its git directory lies elsewhere). The job never commits, pushes or opens a PR: it leaves its changes in the working tree and writes result.json with status, tests and commit_message; the launcher commits and pushes outside the sandbox. For the job's prompt: run no git command that writes (commit, push, config, worktree, stash, add); read-only git only, with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. Codex has no turn limit: deadline_seconds is the only one. Model gpt-6.1-sol at effort high (owner decision 2026-10-12); another model needs its own receipt.
